name: @etzhayyim/wire-rw-free
description: RW-free impl of wire (Consensys c-split). Corridor reference catalog + aggregate corridor stats plaintext (FK via exists()); transfer ledger (parties/amount/currency/status) + secure messages sealed via kotoba E2E (sdk.encryptedWrite/Read, ADR-2605181100). Balances + transfer history derived from the E2E ledger with integer minor-unit math. The fiat merchant-of-record settlement rail EXECUTION stays etzhayyim via consent-capability.
